scripts.features: self explanatory, you can also backflip in different directions based on the direction your going. use shiftlock for better angling.
scripts.script:
local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local jb = 14

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local joint = root:WaitForChild("RootJoint")
	local c0 = joint.C0
	local on = false

	local function stop()
		if on then
			rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("backflip")
			on = false
		end
		if joint.Parent then
			joint.C0 = c0
		end
	end

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
		if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
			if on then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end
		if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		stop()
		on = true
		local md0 = hum.MoveDirection
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local dir
		if md0.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			dir = -Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		else
			local f = md0:Dot(look)
			local r = md0:Dot(right)
			if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then
				dir = f > 0 and look or -look
			else
				dir = r > 0 and right or -right
			end
		end
		local axis = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis:Cross(dir)).Unit
		local g = workspace.Gravity
		local v = (hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight)) + jb
		local dur = math.max(2 * v / g * 0.95, 0.35)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local boosted = false
		rs:BindToRenderStep("backflip", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			if a >= 1 or hum.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
				stop()
				return
			end
			if not boosted then
				boosted = true
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, jb, 0)
			end
			joint.C0 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, a * math.pi * 2) * c0
		end)
	end)
end

if plr.Character then
	task.spawn(setup, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)

-- Educational UI Concept for Reset-Safe State Persistence
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create a ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "PersistentFlightGui"
-- CRUCIAL: Stops Roblox from deleting this UI when you die
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false 
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Main Container Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
MainFrame.Active = true 
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- ==========================================
-- MOBILE FINGER & MOUSE DRAGGING ENGINE
-- ==========================================
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, 
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
        startPos.Y.Scale, 
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)
-- ==========================================

-- Minimize / Maximize Toggle Button
local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 25)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
MinBtn.Text = "-"
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 30, 30)
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- Flight Toggle Button
local FlightButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlightButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 30)
FlightButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
FlightButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlightButton.Parent = MainFrame

-- Directional Controls Frame
local ControlFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 150)
ControlFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
ControlFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ControlFrame.Visible = false
ControlFrame.Parent = MainFrame

-- Helper function to build uniform directional buttons
local function createButton(name, pos, text)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Parent = ControlFrame
    return btn
end

-- Layout direction elements
local UpBtn    = createButton("UpBtn",    UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 5),   "Up")
local LeftBtn  = createButton("LeftBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 50),  "Left")
local RightBtn = createButton("RightBtn", UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50), "Right")
local DownBtn  = createButton("DownBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 95),  "Down")

-- Global States & Physics Trackers
local flightActive = false
local isMinimized = false
local movementVelocity = nil
local rotationGyro = nil
local MOVEMENT_SPEED = 2 

-- References to the active character (changes when you die)
local currentCharacter = nil
local currentHumanoid = nil
local currentRootPart = nil

-- Core function to enable or disable physics setups
local function updatePhysicsState()
    if not currentCharacter or not currentHumanoid or not currentRootPart then return end
    
    -- Clean up any lingering objects from a previous character life
    if movementVelocity then movementVelocity:Destroy() movementVelocity = nil end
    if rotationGyro then rotationGyro:Destroy() rotationGyro = nil end
    
    if flightActive then
        FlightButton.Text = "DISABLE"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
        if not isMinimized then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = MOVEMENT_SPEED
        
        -- Orient character flat immediately
        local flatTargetCFrame = currentRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        currentRootPart.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame
        
        -- Apply locking forces
        rotationGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        rotationGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5) 
        rotationGyro.D = 100 
        rotationGyro.P = 10000 
        rotationGyro.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame 
        rotationGyro.Parent = currentRootPart
        
        movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        movementVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6) 
        movementVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) 
        movementVelocity.Parent = currentRootPart
    else
        FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        currentRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRootPart.Position)
    end
end

-- Hook up Character Re-binding loops (Fires every time you respawn)
local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
    currentCharacter = newCharacter
    currentHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    currentRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Instantly enforce the flight/flat physics if it was left ON when you died
    updatePhysicsState()
end

-- Connect to existing character, and listen for future spawns
if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

-- Minimize/Maximize UI Logic
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 40)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        MinBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
        if flightActive then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        MinBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Manual UI Toggle Button Press Listener
FlightButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    flightActive = not flightActive
    updatePhysicsState()
end)

-- Velocity Controller Direction mapping
local function applyPhysicsVelocity(directionVector)
    if not flightActive or not movementVelocity then return end
    movementVelocity.Velocity = directionVector * MOVEMENT_SPEED
end

-- Button click/tap bindings
UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

LeftBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) end)
LeftBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

RightBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)) end)
RightBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

-- КНОПКА ЗАКРЫТИЯ

local SliderButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

SliderButtonCorner.Parent = SliderButton

-- ТЕКСТ FOV
local FOVLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
FOVLabel.Parent = Panel
FOVLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
FOVLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 205)

FOVLabel.TextScaled = true
FOVLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- ПЕРЕТАСКИВАНИЕ ПАНЕЛИ
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Panel.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

-- ЗАКРЫТИЕ ПАНЕЛИ
CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Panel.Visible = false
end)

-- RIGHT SHIFT ОТКРЫТЬ / ЗАКРЫТЬ
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		Panel.Visible = not Panel.Visible
	end
end)

-- FOV КРУГ
local FOVCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
FOVCircle.Parent = ScreenGui
FOVCircle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
FOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVCircle.BorderSizePixel = 0

	FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
		FOV_RADIUS * 2,
		FOV_RADIUS * 2
	)

	FOVLabel.Text = "FOV: " .. math.floor(FOV_RADIUS)
end

UpdateFOV()

-- SLIDER
local sliderDragging = false

	local left = SliderBackground.AbsolutePosition.X
	local width = SliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X

	local percent = math.clamp(
		(x - left) / width,
		0,
		1
	)

	FOV_RADIUS =
		MIN_FOV + (MAX_FOV - MIN_FOV) * percent

	SliderButton.Position =
		UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)

	UpdateFOV()
end

	sliderDragging = true
end)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		sliderDragging = true
		SetSliderFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if sliderDragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		SetSliderFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		sliderDragging = false
	end
end)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then

		AimButton.Text = "AimLock: ON"
		AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		AimLockEnabled = false
		AimButton.Text = "AimLock: HOLD RMB"
		AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
end)

-- ПРОВЕРКА ВИДНОСТИ
local function IsVisible(Character, Head)
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = Head.Position - origin

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		LocalPlayer.Character
	}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

	if result then
		return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Character)
	end

	return false
end

-- ПОИСК ЦЕЛИ
local function GetClosestHead()
	local closestHead = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- Такой же центр, как у круга
	local screenCenter = Vector2.new(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then

			local Character = Player.Character
			local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local Humanoid =
				Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local position, onScreen =
					Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

				if onScreen then
					local screenPosition =
						Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)

					local distance =
						(screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude

					local insideFOV = true

					if FOVEnabled then
						insideFOV = distance <= FOV_RADIUS
					end

					if insideFOV then
						local canAim = true

						if WallCheckEnabled then
							canAim = IsVisible(Character, Head)
						end

						if canAim and distance < shortestDistance then
							shortestDistance = distance
							closestHead = Head
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestHead
end

-- ESP
local function AddESP(Player)
	if Player == LocalPlayer then return end
	if not ESPEnabled then return end
	if not Player.Character then return end

	if Highlights[Player] then
		Highlights[Player]:Destroy()
	end

	local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
	Highlight.Adornee = Player.Character
	Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
	Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	Highlight.Parent = Player.Character

	Highlights[Player] = Highlight
end

local function RemoveESP(Player)
	if Highlights[Player] then
		Highlights[Player]:Destroy()
		Highlights[Player] = nil
	end
end

local function ToggleESP()
	ESPEnabled = not ESPEnabled

	if ESPEnabled then
		ESPButton.Text = "ESP: ON"
		ESPButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

		for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			AddESP(Player)
		end
	else
		ESPButton.Text = "ESP: OFF"
		ESPButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

		for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			RemoveESP(Player)
		end
	end
end

ESPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleESP)

-- WALL CHECK
WallButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	WallCheckEnabled = not WallCheckEnabled

	if WallCheckEnabled then
		WallButton.Text = "WallCheck: ON"
		WallButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)
	else
		WallButton.Text = "WallCheck: OFF"
		WallButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
end)

-- FOV ON / OFF
FOVButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	FOVEnabled = not FOVEnabled

	if FOVEnabled then
		FOVButton.Text = "FOV: ON"
		FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

		FOVCircle.Visible = true
		SliderBackground.Visible = true
		SliderButton.Visible = true
		FOVLabel.Visible = true
	else
		FOVButton.Text = "FOV: OFF"
		FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)

		FOVCircle.Visible = false
		SliderBackground.Visible = false
		SliderButton.Visible = false
		FOVLabel.Visible = false
	end
end)

-- НОВЫЕ ИГРОКИ И РЕСПАВН
local function SetupPlayer(Player)
	if Player == LocalPlayer then return end

	Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5)

		if ESPEnabled then
			AddESP(Player)
		end
	end)
end

for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	SetupPlayer(Player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(SetupPlayer)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	RemoveESP(Player)
end)

-- ОСНОВНОЙ ЦИКЛ
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- КРУГ ЧУТЬ ВЫШЕ ЦЕНТРА
	FOVCircle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	-- AIMLOCK
	if AimLockEnabled then
		local Head = GetClosestHead()

		if Head then
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(
				Camera.CFrame.Position,
				Head.Position
			)
		end
	end
end)

	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function startFlying()
	character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	
	local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
	
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	bv.Parent = hrp
	
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp
	
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
		
		-- 1. Noclip Loop
		if _G.isNoclip then
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == true then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- 2. Thumbstick Logic (Horizontal Only)
		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		
		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z).Unit
			local flatRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
			flatRight = Vector3.new(flatRight.X, 0, flatRight.Z).Unit
			
			local localMoveDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDirection)
			flatVelocity = (flatLook * -localMoveDirection.Z) + (flatRight * localMoveDirection.X)
			
			if flatVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatVelocity = flatVelocity.Unit * _G.flySpeed
			end
		end
		
		-- 3. Button Logic (Vertical Only)
		local verticalVelocityY = _G.verticalDirection * _G.flySpeed
		
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(flatVelocity.X, verticalVelocityY, flatVelocity.Z)
		
		-- 4. Dynamic Tilt Engine (Faces camera look view)
		local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camLook)
	end)
end

	end
end)

-- Dynamic Slider Drag Calculations
local function updateSpeed(input)
	local relativeX = input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
	local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
	sliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
	_G.flySpeed = math.round(percentage * _G.maxSpeed)
	if _G.flySpeed < 5 then _G.flySpeed = 5 end
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. _G.flySpeed

-- Executor support cheking
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local function Notify(title, text, duration)
    duration = duration or 4

    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = title,
        Text = text,
        Duration = duration
    })

    task.spawn(function()
        local notificationGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") 
            and CoreGui.RobloxGui:FindFirstChild("NotificationFrame")

        if not notificationGui then
            for _, v in pairs(CoreGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if v.Name == "NotificationFrame" or v.Name == "Notification" then
                    notificationGui = v
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if notificationGui then
            notificationGui.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            notificationGui.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
        end
    end)
end

local function getExecutorName()
    if identifyexecutor then
        local name, version = identifyexecutor()
        return name or "Unknown", version
    elseif getexecutorname then
        return getexecutorname(), nil
    end
    return "Unknown", nil
end

local function isSupported()
    local hasHttp = typeof(game.HttpGet) == "function"
    local hasLoadstring = typeof(loadstring) == "function"
    local hasRequest = typeof(request) == "function" or (syn and typeof(syn.request) == "function")
    return hasHttp and hasLoadstring and hasRequest
end

local execName = getExecutorName()

if not isSupported() then
    Notify("CFrameFly", "Executor not supported!\nDetected: " .. execName, 5)
    return
end

Notify("CFrameFly", "Supported: " .. execName .. "\nLoading script...", 3)
